architecture.blocks: Conv7 stride2 + GN8 + ELU + Conv3 + GN8 + ELU + MaxPool2 ceil
architecture.head: 102class linear
architecture.sharing: none with main encoder; independence of errors must be measured

perturbations.time095: multiply signed timestamp by0.95 in float32
perturbations.time105: multiply signed timestamp by1.05 in float32
perturbations.thin01: fixed per(row_id,packet_index) hash removes1% nonzero packets; first valid retained; remaining nonzero packets packed left without time change
perturbations.tail98: retain first ceil(.98*nonzero packet count) valid packets at original positions; others zero
perturbations.tam: reconstruct2x1800 from transformed nonzero timestamps using float64 floor(abs(t)*1799/80) clipped1799, sign direction; original uses existing TAM
perturbations.role: robustness probes, not assumed label preserving; report sourcevalid degradation per view; no target-based view removal

permissions.model: 9 v10 checkpoints explicitly reused SHA verified, eval mode only; all state frozen; no retraining or adaptation
permissions.source: source cache structure only, sourcevalid inputs/labels permitted terminal invariance/ranking diagnostics, no new fitting
permissions.reference: forward/cache/unlabeled statistics only, no reference labels or fitting
permissions.query: independent per-sample transformations and fixed-model inference; labels terminal diagnostics only, no score/model/transform/threshold selection
permissions.identity: same content-supported102class mapping assumption; not official map

score_rules.candidate: v10 unaugmented own-seed prediction; separately fixed v9 smooth prediction, no fusion/new candidate generation
score_rules.baseline: v10 calibrated probability top1-top2 for v10_view; historical v9 raw margin_gain for v9_smooth
score_rules.perturb_support: minimum contrast over4 nonoriginal views of own seed
score_rules.seed_support: minimum contrast over other2 seeds original view
score_rules.joint_support: minimum contrast over all3 seeds x5 views
score_rules.shuffled_joint: same joint scores permuted only among changed candidates by fixed row-id hash; exactly same changed-score multiset; no labels
score_rules.note: bounded probability contrasts, no sigmoid(gain), no GMM risk posterior or quantile rejection; ranking only, no safety guarantee

gates.source_invariance: primary arm all4 perturbations across3seed mean valid MacroF1 drop<=2pp vs original; no deleting failed views
gates.primary: direction_iat/v10_view joint vs baseline: BOTH slices mean Recovery@NAR1 gain>=.5pp, correction-vs-damage AUROC gain>=.03 and absolute>=.65; joint Rec@NAR1 beats shuffled>=.5pp; source invariance must pass
gates.utility: primary plus joint Rec@NAR1 exceeds historical v9smooth by>=.2pp BOTH slices; no automatic integration
gates.secondary: v9_smooth joint vs its own historical margin baseline, same risk/ranking gain tests; report separately, never replace primary
gates.frontier: unique score thresholds from query labels, diagnostics only; maxRecovery at NAR<=1%; no deployment threshold fitting

budget.stop: one fixed batch only; no feedback-driven extra transformations/weights/training, same-config implementation repair documented
